Name: Weeb Stuff
Author: fizzn1
Description:
Hi! I made this mod as a kind of "cosplay" mod for fun. However, i don't see it being "lore unfriendly", as it's not Skyrim and Pelican town DOES have iinfluence from Zuzu city, not to mention TVs that can show broadcasted channels, which technically would include stuff as anime. 
Anyway, I am pretty fine with taking visual content requests.
If you have a visual content request or somethign should be fixed, please sumbit it here: [url=https://gitlab.com/KatouMegumi_osu/sdv_weebstuff/issues]https://gitlab.com/KatouMegumi_osu/sdv_weebstuff/issues[/url]
